approved: Superannuation (Excess Concessional Contributions Tax) Amendment (DisabilityCare Australia) Bill 2013

Moved the Superannuation (Excess Concessional Contributions Tax) Amendment (DisabilityCare Australia) Bill, explaining that the tax rate on excess concessional contributions would rise from 31.5 per cent to 32 per cent from 1 July 2014 to reflect the Medicare levy increase.

Moved to suspend standing orders so that 14 bills related to DisabilityCare Australia (the National Disability Insurance Scheme) could be considered during the current sitting period; the motion was agreed to.
Superannuation (Excess Concessional Contributions Tax) Amendment (DisabilityCare Australia) Act 2013
